sloka: न च पित्रा परित्यक्तो न अमर्यादः कथंचन ।न लुब्धो न च दुःशीलो न च क्षत्रिय पांसनः ॥३-३७-८॥
transliteration: na ca pitrā parityakto na amaryādaḥ kathaṁcana ।na lubdho na ca duḥśīlo na ca kṣatriya pāṁsanaḥ ॥3-37-8॥

translations.english: Rama, the delight of Kausalya, has not forsaken by his father. He has never crossed the limits of dharma. He is not miserly. He has no bad conduct. He is not a slur on the kshatriyas. He does not lack in righteousness. He is not cruel nor is he engaged in doing harm to others.
